title: Packing systems and methods, and grippers for the same

features.item: A housing with a grip portion for gripping and an electrically operated vacuum generating device
features.quote: In one or more examples, gripper 2009 includes vacuum source 2084. Vacuum source 2084 is coupled to or is otherwise in fluid communication with suction cup 2078. Vacuum source 2084 is configured to generate the vacuum used by gripper 2009
features.note: The reference discloses a gripper with a vacuum source (pneumatic piston) and a grip portion (implied by 'gripper'), but it does not explicitly state the vacuum generating device is electrically operated.

features.item: The grip portion is a hollow body
features.note: The reference does not explicitly describe the grip portion as a hollow body.

features.item: Exhaust air from the vacuum generating device is guided through the grip portion to an air outlet
features.note: The reference does not describe exhaust air being guided through the grip portion to an air outlet.

features.item: A sound-damping device is arranged in the grip portion
features.note: The reference does not disclose a sound-damping device arranged in the grip portion.

features.item: A grip unit with hollow grip portion, electrically operated vacuum generator, exhaust air routed through grip to outlet, and sound-damping device in grip portion
features.note: The reference does not disclose a grip unit with all these combined features, specifically lacking a hollow grip portion, exhaust air routed through the grip, and a sound-damping device in the grip portion.

features.item: A vacuum handling apparatus comprising a suction plate with carrier plate and seal, and a grip unit with hollow grip portion, electrically operated vacuum generator, exhaust air routed through grip to outlet, and sound-damping device
features.quote: In one or more examples, gripper 2009 includes suction cup 2078. Suction cup 2078 is configured to contact a surface of container 101 and apply the vacuum to container 101 to secure container 101 to receiving end 2043 of gripper
features.note: The reference discloses a gripper with a suction cup (which acts as a suction plate with a seal) and a vacuum generator. However, it does not specify an electrically operated vacuum generator, a hollow grip portion, exhaust air routed through the grip, or a sound-damping device.

features.item: The grip portion is at least partially lined with sound-damping material
features.note: The reference does not disclose the grip portion being lined with sound-damping material.

features.item: The vacuum generating device is arranged completely in a first housing portion
features.quote: In one or more examples, vacuum source 2484 includes drive cylinder 2481 that forms third vacuum cavity 2473 and drive member 2475. Drive member 2475 is situated and closely fit within third vacuum cavity 2473, such that drive member 2475
features.note: The reference describes a vacuum source with a drive cylinder and drive member forming a vacuum cavity, which could be considered a housing portion. However, it does not explicitly state that the *entire* vacuum generating device is *completely* arranged in a *first* housing portion, nor does it define a 'first housing portion' in the context of the overall gripper.

features.item: A sound-reducing device is arranged in the first housing portion or the first housing portion is lined with sound-reducing material
features.note: The reference does not disclose any sound-reducing device or lining in any housing portion.

features.item: The grip portion is elongated between the first housing portion and a second housing portion, with air outlet on the second housing portion
features.note: The reference does not describe an elongated grip portion between two housing portions with an air outlet on the second housing portion.

features.item: An air collection screw arranged upstream of the grip portion in the first housing portion for collecting exhaust air
features.note: The reference does not disclose an air collection screw or any specific mechanism for collecting exhaust air upstream of a grip portion.

features.item: Bent or curved air baffles downstream of the grip portion for guiding exhaust air to the air outlet
features.note: The reference does not disclose bent or curved air baffles for guiding exhaust air.

features.item: A battery coupling point on the second housing portion with air baffles directing exhaust air away from the battery coupling point
features.note: The reference does not disclose a battery coupling point or air baffles directing exhaust air away from it.

features.item: The grip unit and suction plate are releasably connected via a coupling device
features.quote: In one or more examples, receiving end 2343 is removable from gripper body 2344. Removal of receiving end 2343 from gripper body 2344 enables different receiving ends to be interchanged, as needed, such as having a different style or size
features.note: The reference discloses that the receiving end (which includes the suction cup/plate) is removable from the gripper body, implying a releasable connection. However, it does not explicitly refer to a 'grip unit' as a separate component from the gripper body, nor does it specify the type of coupling device.

features.item: The grip unit has a suction opening fluidically connected to a suction chamber delimited by the suction plate
features.quote: The vacuum is supplied or otherwise transferred to suction cup 2078 from vacuum source 2084, for example, via vacuum supply line 2088. Vacuum supply line 2088 is any suitable pneumatic line, such as a hose, tube or the like.
features.note: The reference describes a vacuum supply line connecting the vacuum source to the suction cup, which forms a suction chamber when in contact with a container. This implies a fluid connection from the 'grip unit' (containing the vacuum source) to the suction chamber.
features.refuted: The quote describes how vacuum is supplied to a suction cup, but does not mention a suction opening or a suction chamber delimited by a suction plate.

claims.note: The reference describes a gripper for a packaging system, not a grip unit for a vacuum hand-operated laying device for use with a suction plate.

claims.quote: [paragraph 0157] In one or more examples, gripper 2009 includes vacuum source 2084. Vacuum source 2084 is coupled to or is otherwise in fluid communication with suction cup 2078.
claims.note: The reference discloses a gripper with a vacuum generating device (vacuum source 2084), but it does not specify an 'electrically operated' vacuum generating device or a 'grip portion' as described in the claim context.
The reference describes a 'gripper body' but does not describe a 'grip portion' designed as a hollow body.
The reference does not describe exhaust air from a vacuum generating device being guided through a grip portion to an air outlet, nor a sound-damping device in the grip portion.
The reference describes grippers that use vacuum, but there is no mention of a sound-damping device arranged in a grip portion or any sound damping at all.
The reference does not describe any part of a gripper being lined with a sound-damping material.
The reference describes a vacuum generating device but does not specify its arrangement within a 'first housing portion' of a housing.
The reference does not mention a sound-reducing device or sound-reducing material in any housing portion.

The reference describes a gripper with a suction body and suction cup, but does not mention a grip portion elongated between a first and second housing portion, nor an air outlet arranged on a second housing portion.

The reference describes a vacuum system for a gripper, but does not disclose an air collection device in the form of an air collection screw arranged upstream of a grip portion in a first housing portion.
The reference describes a vacuum gripper system, but does not mention bent or curved air baffles arranged downstream of a grip portion to guide exhaust air to an air outlet.

The reference describes a gripper and a system for packing containers, but does not disclose a battery coupling point for an electrical energy storage device or rechargeable battery on the housing, nor air baffles for directing exhaust air away from such a coupling point.
The reference does not disclose air baffles for directing exhaust air away from a battery coupling point.

claims.quote: [abstract] A gripper (2409) for a packaging system includes a suction body (2474) forming a first vacuum cavity (2476) and a suction cup (2478) coupled to the suction body (2474) and forming a second vacuum cavity (2482).
claims.note: The abstract describes a gripper for a packaging system that uses suction, which is a type of vacuum handling apparatus.
claims.refuted: The quote describes a gripper, which is a component of a vacuum handling apparatus, but it does not describe the entire apparatus itself. It focuses on the gripper's internal structure (suction body, vacuum cavities, suction cup) rather than the overall apparatus.

claims.quote: [paragraph 0162] In one or more examples, suction cup 2078 is coupled to or extends from receiving end 2043 of gripper 2009. In one or more examples, suction cup 2078 is flexible.
claims.note: The reference discloses a suction cup coupled to a receiving end (carrier plate equivalent) and being flexible (a type of seal), but does not explicitly state the seal extends around the carrier plate.
The reference does not contain the full text of claim 1 of the subject invention, which is required to assess this limitation.

claims.quote: In one or more examples, receiving end 2343 is removable from gripper body 2344. Removal of receiving end 2343 from gripper body 2344 enables different receiving ends to be interchanged
claims.note: The reference discloses that the receiving end (which includes the suction cup/plate) is removable from the gripper body, implying a releasable connection.
claims.refuted: The quote states that the receiving end is removable from the gripper body, allowing for interchangeability. This supports the idea of releasable connection but does not explicitly mention a 'coupling device' as the means of connection, nor does it refer to a 'grip unit' and 'suction plate' specific

claims.quote: Suction cup 2478 forms second vacuum cavity 2482. Second vacuum cavity 2482 of suction cup 2478 is in selective fluid communication with first vacuum cavity 2476 of suction body 2474.
claims.note: The reference discloses a suction cup forming a vacuum cavity and fluid communication to a suction body, which generates vacuum. However, it does not explicitly mention a 'suction opening' on the grip unit that is fluidically connected to a suction chamber delimited by the suction plate.

overall.why: The reference discloses a vacuum gripper system with a vacuum source and suction cup for handling containers, and some features related to the modularity and operation of the vacuum system.
